propositions: Environment-read helper functions absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS table are silently invisible to the registry scanner, allowing env-var references at call sites to be undocumented even though advertised to operators in CLI help

The parameterized-shim predicate (functions whose os.environ key expressions reference their own parameters) identifies 9 env-read helpers in the tree; three are unregistered, causing REBAR_GATE_REF, REBAR_GATE_SOURCE, and JIRA_API_TOKEN to be missing or misattributed in the generated registry

Adding fail-closed detection for unregistered parameterized shims must raise UnregisteredEnvReadHelper naming the site, mirroring the existing fail-closed behavior for unrecognized os.environ attributes

Regeneration of docs/env-vars.md after registering _gate_str_pref, read_secret_env, and _env_truthy restores the documented variable count from 162 to 164, eliminating the silent loss that has occurred twice (bug b00f and this ticket)
Stale rows with no corresponding def site under src/rebar (four of eleven: _rebar_env, _env_int, _str_pref, _int_pref) exist as a separate ghost-row defect distinct from missing-helper failures
